items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: I come back here and went with Dave Payton's band, Regal Theater.

ctx.x: And you had another clarinet in there before or not?

Yeah, with clarinet. There was a little, well, they weren't much clarinet players. The alto saxophone players played a little clarinet. Wiggles they called it. Poirier. Poirier to hell. So, we go to Wake. We go to Wake in Estoria. And so, I take a little Danny Barker. I had a band, put him in. He never played music. I brought him music well. We go up there and I went to Wake for Beansy. And I stayed up there and clean until I joined Lou Russell's band, New York. Saratoga Club. 29, I leave New Orleans and go to…
